meta.name: golden-pptx
meta.description: Use when testing the pptx golden build

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证PPTX生成功能是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify PPTX generation works correctly

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以基于一份名为“The Deck”的演示文稿，回答关于其内容的问题，包括概念、代码示例、表格数据等。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于“golden_pptx”演示文稿的内容，或要求查看其中的代码、表格、章节等信息时触发。

say.text: “The Deck”演示文稿的安装步骤是什么？
say.note: Claude 会从文稿中提取安装步骤。

say.text: 给我看看“The Deck”里的 Python 代码示例。
say.note: Claude 会列出文稿中的 Python 代码。

say.text: “The Deck”的架构概览章节有哪些内容？
say.note: Claude 会总结该章节的要点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer questions about the content of a presentation titled 'The Deck', including concepts, code examples, table data, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about the content of the 'golden_pptx' presentation, or requests to view code, tables, sections, etc.

say_en.text: What are the installation steps in 'The Deck'?
say_en.note: Claude extracts installation steps from the deck.

say_en.text: Show me the Python code examples from 'The Deck'.
say_en.note: Claude lists Python code from the deck.

say_en.text: What is in the Architecture Overview section of 'The Deck'?
